full_judgment: 33. In respect of the said Exhibit-Ga it may also be pointed out that the same is hit by section 107 of the Transfer of Properly Act since no corresponding kabuliyat was executed by Hari Das Roy or Hari Mohan Roy in favour of the executants, therefore, those two documents Exhibits-Ga and Ga (1) are mere unilateral ones as opposed to the requirements of section 107 of the Transfer of Property Act. In this connection we can safely hold that the decision cited by the learned Advocate for the appellant and reported in 26 DLR 45 and 2(ADC) Appellate Division Cases 54 is very much appealable in this appeal.
